一、情景用语与口语

拓展：Carlos 和 Kate（Pair A）

Extension · 1–3

口语 · 写

Pair A: 1 Read about Carlos. Then answer the questions. Write full sentences. 2 Read about Kate. Write questions to find the missing information. 3 Ask and answer your questions with Student B.

A：读 Carlos 的介绍回答问题；读 Kate 的介绍，写问题找出缺失信息；再和 B 互问互答。

Carlos is a scientist and he works at a university. He gets up at 7.30 and he has breakfast with his wife. He starts work at nine o’clock and he finishes at 5.30. He has sandwiches for lunch. After work, Carlos goes cycling. Then he has dinner. In the evening he sometimes plays the piano and reads detective stories. He goes to bed early. At the weekend, Carlos goes to bed late and gets up late. In summer, he plays tennis and he goes swimming. In winter, he goes skiing in the mountains. On Fridays, he goes to the cinema. On Saturdays, he has dinner in a restaurant with his friends.

1 Where does Carlos work?　2 Who does he have breakfast with?　3 What time does he finish work?　4 What does he have for lunch?　5 What does he do after work?　6 What does he read in the evening?　7 What does he do in summer?　8 Where does he go skiing?　9 Where does he go on Fridays?　10 When does he have dinner in a restaurant?

Kate is a receptionist and she lives in 1______. She works for a small company. In her job, she talks to 2______. Kate gets up at 3______ every morning. Kate starts work at 8.30. She has lunch in 4______ with her colleagues. After work, she usually goes home or she meets 5______. On 6______, she has a Spanish class. After the class, she 7______ with her classmates. On 8______, Kate goes shopping. She goes to the market. She buys vegetables, fruit and 9______ for lunch. In the evening, she stays at home and watches TV. At the weekend, she goes to 10______. She loves climbing.

Write questions 1–10 to find the missing information.

一、情景用语与口语

拓展：Kate 和 Carlos（Pair B）

Extension · 1–3

口语 · 写

Pair B: 1 Read about Kate. Then answer the questions. Write full sentences. 2 Read about Carlos. Write questions to find the missing information. 3 Ask and answer your questions with Student A.

B：读 Kate 的介绍回答问题；读 Carlos 的介绍，写问题找出缺失信息；再和 A 互问互答。

Kate is a receptionist and she works in London. She works for a small company. In her job, she talks to customers. Kate gets up at seven o’clock every morning. Kate starts work at 8.30. She has lunch in a café with her colleagues. After work, she usually goes home or she meets her sister. On Wednesdays, she has a Spanish class. After the class, she has dinner with her classmates. On Fridays, Kate goes shopping. She goes to the market. She buys vegetables, fruit and cheese for lunch. In the evening, she stays at home and watches TV. At the weekend, she goes to the mountains. She loves climbing.

1 Where does Kate work?　2 Who does she talk to at work?　3 What time does she get up?　4 Where does she have lunch?　5 Who does she meet after work?　6 When does she have a Spanish class?　7 What does she do after the class?　8 When does she go to the market?　9 What does she buy for lunch?　10 Where does she go at the weekend?

Carlos is a scientist and he works at a 1______. He gets up at 7.30 and he has breakfast with 2______. He starts work at nine o’clock and he finishes at 3______. He has 4______ for lunch. After work, Carlos 5______. Then he has dinner. In the evening he sometimes plays the piano and reads 6______. He goes to bed early. At the weekend, Carlos goes to bed late and gets up late. In summer, he 7______ and he goes swimming. In winter, he goes skiing in 8______. On Fridays, he goes to 9______. On 10______, he has dinner in a restaurant with his friends. Carlos likes weekends!

Write questions 1–10 to find the missing information.

二、语法 · 一般现在时 he / she / it

课本 7a：找动词、补全句子

课本 7a · 3

Look at the grammar box. Underline the verbs with present simple forms in the article.

看语法框，在文章里给一般现在时的动词画线。

Ruth loves her job. She works for a drone company in Rwanda. The company flies drones to hospitals around Rwanda. Each drone carries medicines. Ruth is a drone operator. She works in a town called Muhanga. It’s near the capital, Kigali.
Ruth doesn’t visit the hospitals. She puts the medicines in the drone and she checks the drone. The drone takes the medicines to the destination. Ruth stays in Muhanga. She operates the drone. It flies at 70 kilometres an hour and it can travel 100 kilometres.
The drone goes to difficult places in the mountains. It helps doctors to do their jobs.

3 A drone operator ______ (not/travel) with the drone.
4 A drone ______ (carry) medicines.
5 A drone operator ______ (prepare) a drone.
6 A drone operator ______ (not/wear) a uniform.

六、阅读

课本 7a：An unusual job

Ruth loves her job. She works for a drone company in Rwanda. The company flies drones to hospitals around Rwanda. Each drone carries medicines. Ruth is a drone operator. She works in a town called Muhanga. It’s near the capital, Kigali.
Ruth doesn’t visit the hospitals. She puts the medicines in the drone and she checks the drone. The drone takes the medicines to the destination. Ruth stays in Muhanga. She operates the drone. It flies at 70 kilometres an hour and it can travel 100 kilometres.
The drone goes to difficult places in the mountains. It helps doctors to do their jobs.

六、阅读

课本 7c：Helping big cats（文章）

TIGERS　Number of wild tigers in the world: in 1900 – 100,000; in 2023 – 5,574.
Tigers live in many places in Asia – from very cold mountains in the Himalayas to very hot areas. They usually live in places without people, but people sometimes move into forest areas with tigers. Tigers eat other animals. They usually kill wild animals, but they sometimes kill domestic animals. Tigers need our help because local people move into their areas and they sometimes kill the tigers.
HELPING TIGERS　Tigers in Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Park, Thailand: in 1980 – 20; in 2021 – 89.
Saksit Simcharoen works at the Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Park in Thailand. The park is a very good place for tigers. Saksit goes into the forest at night. He doesn’t see many tigers, but the park has about 200 cameras. They can take photos of tigers. Saksit checks the cameras. About 20 of the tigers in the park have radio collars. Every month, Saksit writes a report about the tigers in the area.

六、阅读

单元测试阅读：Dan 的三份工作

Dan works hard. He has three different jobs!
From Monday to Friday, he is a teacher, but he doesn’t teach at school. He works from his home in New York and teaches English by computer. His students don’t go to his house. He usually works during the mornings and afternoons with students from Europe and also Brazil. He sometimes teaches at night when he has students in China or Japan, when it is morning for them. Dan often asks his students questions about photos and films, and they sometimes send him emails in English.
On Friday evenings and Saturdays, Dan works as a waiter in a French restaurant. He likes the job because it helps him meet new people, and he eats there too. He says the food is great.
Dan can also play the guitar, and he sometimes plays in a band with some friends on Saturday and Sunday evenings.
